show.description: General's Reborn Heiress- Living Carefree: Story follows a reborn young lady who, after escaping betrayal in her past life, uses her wit and courage to rewrite her destiny. With a carefree spirit, she outsmarts enemies, protects her loved ones, and lives life on her own terms.
